protocol: existing v4 within-set leave-one-out; no new supervised split
scope: All rows loaded by the existing published-parquet v4 loader, no sample cap
grouping: Exact source-image byte identity; duplicate byte-identical images share a group
group_limitation: Parquet patch identifiers do not supply verified patient/slide membership. Do not label image-conditional uncertainty as patient-level uncertainty; patient-level statistics await a mapping.
